title: Perplexity ships autonomous self-improving agent skills feature in Computer product
content:
X author: @perplexity_ai

Perplexity launched an autonomous improvement agent called Brain in its Computer product that observes user sessions, creates and updates personalized reusable skills, with measured improvements in tool call success and user satisfaction now available to subscribers.

Linked sources:
- https://www.perplexity.ai/hub/blog/self-improving-skills

novelty.reason: This is a new development regarding Perplexity's launch of an autonomous self-improving agent skills feature called Brain in its Computer product, distinct from its previously reported multiagent architecture.
